description: Mondelz International's purpose is to empower people to snack right, and it sells its products in over 150 countries around the world, being one of the world's largest snack companies with global net revenues of $38.5 billion and net earnings of $2.5 billion in 2025. Its core business is making and selling chocolate, biscuits and baked snacks, and it also has additional businesses in adjacent, locally relevant categories including gum & candy, cheese & grocery and powdered beverages, with a portfolio that includes iconic global and local brands such as Oreo, Ritz, LU, Clif Bar and Tate's Bake Shop biscuits and baked snacks, as well as Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate, and it strives to create a positive impact on the world and communities in which it operates while driving business performance, with the goal of leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.
